svg.text: CypherMonkey · Webex Lab · not a vendor document
Organization — Name the full administrator and confirm new users have no admin role.
Identity — Directory Connector or SCIM, then SSO. Do not run both creators for the same people.
Location — Address, main number, PSTN connection, emergency address.
Trunk — Certificate or registration. FQDN matches the certificate. SIP ALG off.
Users — License, number, device claim, recording provider chosen first.
